prompt: Let's ___ we share the taxi fare; how much would each person pay?
explanation_ru: В значении «предположим / допустим» используется устойчивое выражение Let's say.

prompt: The service at that new bistro was slow, to ___ the least.
explanation_ru: Вводный оборот to say the least означает «мягко говоря».

prompt: It goes without ___ that safety goggles must be worn inside the workshop.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение It goes without saying переводится как «само собой разумеется».

prompt: Seldom has a visiting scientist ___ to such a crowded lecture hall without glancing at a single note.
explanation_ru: Для официального публичного выступления перед аудиторией используется глагол speak (speak to an audience).

prompt: “Good morning, could I ___ to Ms Alvarez in customer support, please?”
explanation_ru: В вежливом телефонном обращении с просьбой позвать кого-либо к телефону используется speak to.

prompt: Yesterday evening, a veteran mountaineer ___ to an audience of three hundred students at the community centre.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения выступления с речью перед слушателями употребляется глагол speak (spoke to an audience).

prompt: The traffic was so loud that the tour leader had to ___ up so everyone could hear.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол speak up означает «говорить громче».

prompt: This morning the manager ___ me off for arriving twenty minutes late to the shift.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол tell someone off означает «отчитать / отругать кого-либо».

prompt: The kitchen is rather narrow. Having ___ that, the natural light is wonderful.
explanation_ru: Устойчивая связка Having said that означает «тем не менее / при этом».

prompt: We promised not to ___ shop during our weekend camping trip, even though we are all colleagues.
explanation_ru: Идиома talk shop означает «говорить о работе в нерабочее время».

prompt: “Hello, is that Mr Carter?” — “___. How may I assist you?”
explanation_ru: В телефонном разговоре ответ «Speaking» означает «Я у телефона / Слушаю вас».

prompt: You're ___ complete nonsense if you believe we can finish painting the whole house in one afternoon.
explanation_ru: В значении «нести чушь / говорить ерунду» используется устойчивое сочетание talk nonsense.

prompt: It goes without telling that you should save your work regularly.
answer: It goes without saying that you should save your work regularly.
accepted_answers: It goes without saying that you should save your work regularly.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «само собой разумеется» используется глагол saying (It goes without saying), а не telling.

prompt: Could you speak up? There is a lot of static on the line.
answer: Could you speak up? There is a lot of static on the line.
accepted_answers: Could you speak up? There is a lot of static on the line.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: фразовый глагол speak up («говорить громче») употреблён правильно.

prompt: To say the truth, I find the original poster design much more striking.
answer: To tell the truth, I find the original poster design much more striking.
accepted_answers: To tell the truth, I find the original poster design much more striking.
explanation_ru: С существительным truth используется глагол tell: To tell the truth («по правде говоря»).

prompt: In a close-knit industry like ours, people are bound to say if a director walks out of a board meeting early.
answer: In a close-knit industry like ours, people are bound to talk if a director walks out of a board meeting early.
accepted_answers: In a close-knit industry like ours, people are bound to talk if a director walks out of a board meeting early.
explanation_ru: В значении «сплетничать / судачить» употребляется непереходный глагол talk (people talk), а не say.

prompt: Dr Lin is scheduled to say at the climate summit in Geneva next month.
answer: Dr Lin is scheduled to speak at the climate summit in Geneva next month.
accepted_answers: Dr Lin is scheduled to speak at the climate summit in Geneva next month.
explanation_ru: Для выступления с докладом или речью на конференции используется глагол speak (speak at a conference).

prompt: In a small neighbourhood like this, people always talk when a new family moves into the corner house.
answer: In a small neighbourhood like this, people always talk when a new family moves into the corner house.
accepted_answers: In a small neighbourhood like this, people always talk when a new family moves into the corner house.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: глагол talk верно передаёт значение «сплетничать, обсуждать новости».

prompt: Our striker missed two penalties. Having told that, she scored the winning goal in extra time.
answer: Our striker missed two penalties. Having said that, she scored the winning goal in extra time.
accepted_answers: Our striker missed two penalties. Having said that, she scored the winning goal in extra time.
explanation_ru: В вводной конструкции «тем не менее / при всём при том» используется форма said (Having said that).

prompt: Several local residents have said out against the plan to close the community library.
answer: Several local residents have spoken out against the plan to close the community library.
accepted_answers: Several local residents have spoken out against the plan to close the community library.
explanation_ru: Для выражения открытого протеста или публичного высказывания мнения используется фразовый глагол speak out (spoken out).

prompt: You want to encourage a colleague to express their honest opinion during the planning meeting. Which sentence is natural?
options: You should say your mind when we review the project schedule.
You should speak your mind when we review the project schedule.
You should tell your mind when we review the project schedule.
You should talk your mind when we review the project schedule.
explanation_ru: Идиома speak one's mind означает «прямо высказать своё мнение».

prompt: Students were whispering quietly to each other during the assembly until the principal asked for silence. Which sentence is correct?
options: Only after the principal raised a hand did the students finally stop saying among themselves.
Only after the principal raised a hand did the students finally stop talking among themselves.
Only after the principal raised a hand did the students finally stop telling among themselves.
Only after the principal raised a hand did the students finally stop whispering among themselves.
explanation_ru: Для неформальной беседы людей друг с другом используется выражение talk among themselves.

prompt: Two childhood friends met at a café and spent the whole afternoon catching up. Which sentence sounds natural?
options: The two old friends sat by the window and talked for hours about their university days.
The two old friends sat by the window and said for hours about their university days.
The two old friends sat by the window and told for hours about their university days.
The two old friends sat by the window and stated for hours about their university days.
explanation_ru: Для продолжительной дружеской беседы о чём-либо используется глагол talk (talk about something).

prompt: Two colleagues love tennis and always discuss matches on their morning commute. Which sentence is natural?
options: Whenever those two colleagues ride the train together, they say tennis the entire trip.
Whenever those two colleagues ride the train together, they talk tennis the entire trip.
Whenever those two colleagues ride the train together, they tell tennis the entire trip.
Whenever those two colleagues ride the train together, they speak tennis the entire trip.
explanation_ru: В разговорном английском конструкция talk + тема (talk tennis, talk business) означает «обсуждать данную тему».

prompt: During yesterday's town hall meeting, Maya voiced her honest opinion even though others disagreed. Which sentence is correct?
options: At yesterday's meeting, Maya spoke out despite the objections.
At yesterday's meeting, Maya said out despite the objections.
At yesterday's meeting, Maya told out despite the objections.
At yesterday's meeting, Maya talked out despite the objections.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол speak out означает «открыто высказаться / выступить с заявлением» (в прошлом времени — spoke out).

prompt: All copies of the new cooking book sold out within an hour, clearly showing how popular it is. Which sentence is natural?
options: Those empty display tables tell volumes about customer interest.
Those empty display tables say volumes about customer interest.
Those empty display tables speak volumes about customer interest.
Those empty display tables talk volumes about customer interest.
explanation_ru: Идиома speak volumes (about something) означает «быть весьма красноречивым / говорить о многом».

prompt: The garage is our family workshop, so to (speak / talk).
explanation_ru: Вводный оборот so to speak переводится как «так сказать».

prompt: As soon as the receptionist asked who was (speaking / saying), the caller hung up.
explanation_ru: В телефонном этикете для вопроса «кто говорит / кто звонит?» используется глагол speak (who is speaking).

prompt: “Good afternoon, could I (speak / say) to Mr Bennett, please?” — “One moment, I'll transfer your call.”
explanation_ru: В телефонных разговорах с предлогом to используется глагол speak (speak to someone).

prompt: Ignore Leo when he gives baking advice — he has never used an oven and is just (talking / saying) through his hat.
explanation_ru: Идиома talk through one's hat означает «нести вздор / рассуждать о том, в чём совершенно не разбираешься».

prompt: We finally (talked / said) my brother out of buying a third big dog yesterday.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone out of doing something означает «отговорить кого-либо от какого-то поступка».
